title: Status: Status with ping animation (daisyUI)
notes:
Status is a really small icon to visually show the current status of an element, like online, offline, error, etc.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/status/+page.md
